headline: PHI @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 4.56 at BOS 2.92, with a projected total of 7.49. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PHI: PHI moved +0.10 runs while BOS moved -0.76, changing the projected margin by +0.87 runs. The projected total fell -0.66, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +19.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Ranger Suarez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Brandon Marsh, Trevor Story, Ceddanne Rafaela, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Adolis García, Carlos Narváez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
